IAS Officer Rinku Singh Rahee Issued Show-Cause Notice Over Allegations

IAS officer Rinku Singh Rahee has been issued a show-cause notice following a complaint. The notice, reportedly six pages long, details allegations against Rahee. She has been given 15 days to respond, with further action threatened if she fails to do so. The complaint was reportedly delivered in the form of a letter.
